# How much of the leftover 529 can you move into a Roth IRA, and when?

> Free 529-to-Roth IRA rollover calculator: the 15-year rule, five-year contribution lock, $35,000 lifetime cap, annual limit and earned income, year by year. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
